title: root_authorization.json DODAGID binding still native profile: corpus and python check agree on rejected SHA-512 derivation (vacuous green)
description: Latent residual of the same class nwm8 fixed for rpl_messages.json. python/tests/test_protocol_vector_security.py test_root_vectors_use_native_addr_for_key_and_independent_signatures (lines ~443-464, name itself says native) checks root_authorization.json vectors with _addr_for_key (file:48, the REJECTED native SHA-512 profile: 0x02 || sha512(pubkey)[:7] || masked sha512(pubkey)[:8]). The corpus dodagids match that native derivation, so the test is green — but both sides pin the rejected profile instead of upstream Yggdrasil AddrForKey. Settled decision (spec/decisions.jsonl upstream-yggdrasil-addressing): DODAGID MUST be AddrForKey(pubkey). Fix shape: flip root_authorization_vectors builder in test/vectors/generate.py to upstream_addr_for_key, regen, flip the check (lines 443 and 458) to reference_schnorr48.upstream_addr_for_key. Before flipping, check consumers of root_authorization.json (Rust root-sig fixtures were migrated to the i72x.6.a corpus in c5b6e83d58 — confirm whether this JSON is still consumed or superseded).
